summary:
I wrote $HOME/projects/llm/llamacpp/README.md. No other file in the project was created or changed. My only other writes were source fetches into the scratchpad (lc-src, lc-reg, tools).

The document covers the image choice, a run template, a Compose equivalent, MoE expert offload, KV quantization, thinking control, the prompt cache, tool calling, Unsloth Dynamic quants, a known-issues table, smoke tests, troubleshooting, Sources and Maintenance. It links to llamacpp/models.md, llamacpp/benchmarking.md, docs/host-setup.md, docs/opencode.md, docs/model-selection.md, docs/sources.md and vllm/README.md.

**Applied input corrections:**
- `-e GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1` goes before the image name. After it, llama-server reads `-e` as `--escape` (arg.cpp line 1832).
- The CUDA 12.8.1 image is chosen because of the cuda13 image's NVIDIA_REQUIRE_CUDA check, not because of #28581. #28581 is kept as a note about self-built CUDA 13.2 binaries.
- `--n-cpu-moe` counts blocks from 0, not MoE layers (the Nemotron Lightning example).
- The >80k cliff in the #27623 title is marked as retracted.
- The Unsloth Qwen3.8 UD-Q3_K_XL file was replaced with a V3.1 build on 2026-11-12.
- b12418 is a pre-release; v1.0.0 (2026-11-13) is the latest stable release.

**Checked live on 2026-11-15** (curl and gh against primary sources; read-only):
- **GHCR tags:** server-cuda-b12407, full-cuda-b12407, light-cuda-b12407 and server-cuda13-b12407 return 200. server-cuda-b12418, b12419 and b12420 return 404. server-cuda has the same digest as b12407 (sha256:22bd49f4...).
- **llama-bench:** only the full image has it. cuda.Dockerfile copies all of build/bin into full, and tools.sh runs it with `--bench`. The server image has only llama and llama-server.
- **Flags and defaults at b12418:** `--cache-reuse` (default 0), `--ctx-checkpoints` (default 32), `--cache-ram` (default 8192 MiB), `-ot`, `--reasoning-budget-message`, `--metrics`, the `HF_TOKEN` default for `--hf-token`, and `llama-fit-params`.
- **Deprecation:** setting `enable_thinking` through `--chat-template-kwargs` logs a warning pointing to `--reasoning on|off`.
- **Per-request kwargs:** they override the server defaults, and `enable_thinking` sent as a string returns HTTP 400.
- **Quantized V cache:** needs flash attention (llama-context.cpp line 617).
- **Issue states:** #27330, #30357, #32316, #30118, #29655, #29947, #27623, #25859 and #28581 are open, and PR #31802 is open. PR #26939 merged on 2026-08-20.
- **#32316:** a 2026-11-15 comment traces the re-prefill to `--ctx-checkpoints 0`.

**Estimates:** the memory cap in the run template (20g for Qwen3.6, about 9 GiB of experts plus the 8 GiB `--cache-ram` default plus overhead) is my own estimate and is labelled that way. It differs from the synthesis figure of 14g, which left out `--cache-ram`.
unverified: Whether server-cuda13-b12407 is actually refused on this GeForce laptop: inferred from the image's NVIDIA_REQUIRE_CUDA and NVIDIA's docs, not tested (the toolkit is not installed).
The 2026-10-12 comment on #27330 reproducing the hang on Ubuntu 26.04 with driver 595.99.02: taken from the input records. I read the issue body and early comments, not that comment itself.
The speed cost of GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 on this laptop: unmeasured.
The 20g container cap, --n-cpu-moe 21 and every VRAM or RAM figure: estimates. Nothing was run on this laptop.
That b12407 (the pinned image) has the same flags and defaults as b12418, where they were read. Only the tags and digest were checked for b12407.
Whether --cache-reuse is also disabled for qwen35moe (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B), not only qwen35: #32316 names LLM_ARCH_QWEN35.
The #28581 fix in CUDA 13.2.2 and later: from the audit/challenger record, not re-read.
Whether llama-bench accepts -hf: not checked, so the README only points to benchmarking.md.
Configured DDR5 DIMM speed on this machine (102.4 GB/s is the theoretical spec figure).
Compose passthrough of an unset HF_TOKEN: not verified, so the Compose example omits HF_TOKEN and just says to add it for gated repos.
